About This Game

Censorship Bureau · Notice of Appointment

You are hereby appointed Broadcast Supervisor for State Channel One. Report for duty today. Your first shift begins tonight. Your five-day assignment ends with the Foundation Day Parade. Keep the broadcasts running without incident.

Glory to Vesna.

────────────────

HAPPY PROPAGANDA is a short, branching adventure set in Vesna, a fictional state that espouses communism. Moderate comments on state television and spend five days working alongside its rookie presenter, Happy Lun.

Presenter Record

Approve or censor?

Support, small talk, questions about the government, insults aimed at the presenter. Read the comments automatically flagged by Censor Buddy and decide whether to let them through or remove them. Ignoring a deletion order lowers your rating; deleting too much fuels public discontent. Letting insults through can placate the audience, but wears down the presenter's Stability.

Read the news. Choose tonight's topic.

Check the morning paper, your inbox, and in-game websites before the broadcast. Use what you learn to choose a featured topic. What goes on air changes the comments that come in.

The broadcast ends. Your words stay with her.

Talk to the presenter before and after each show. How will you respond when she reveals the worries she keeps off-air? Your everyday conversations shape your relationship.

Five days. Multiple endings.

The Foundation Day Parade marks your final day. The decisions you make and the words you choose along the way affect how the story ends.

────────────────

— For prospective personnel —
Adding the game to your wishlist will be treated as a request to receive your appointment notice. Your orders will arrive on release day.

— Streaming and video guidelines —

  • Let's Plays, livestreams, and videos are welcome, including monetized content!

  • Please keep major spoilers out of titles and thumbnails.

  • A link to the Steam store page in your description is appreciated.

Download images, videos, GIFs, and the full guidelines from the Steam News post “Streaming guidelines and creator assets”. Separate asset folders are available for all seven supported languages.
